name: Mission 1: Defend the Town
description: Raiders have been spotted near the town. Put your peasant to work, muster your militia, and hold the Town Hall. Survive every attacker to win.

name: Mission 2: Rebuild the Walls
description: The raids will not stop. Build a Gold Mine for income and raise a Palisade â€” buildings take time to construct, so put your peasants to work early.

name: Mission 3: The Chief Returns
description: The Town Chief is back from the capital. Heroes fight on the battlefield and have powerful abilities â€” use them, because a Raider Champion is coming.

name: Mission 4: Strike Back
description: Scouts found the raiders' forward camp. This time you attack: destroy the Raider Camp before their reinforcements wear you down.

name: Mission 5: The Rival Village
description: The Town Chief arrives from the capital. A rival settlement now challenges your borders â€” more organised than raiders. Defeat their Town Hall.

name: Mission 6: Build the Barracks
description: The rival settlement has trained soldiers and built a barracks. Match them â€” build your own and begin training.

name: Mission 7: The Archer Corps
description: The rival has learned to use archers. Train yours before their arrows drive your soldiers from the field.

name: Mission 8: Walls of Stone
description: They have raised walls and stationed archers behind them. This rival town is serious â€” fortify and assault. You will need a Knight to break through.

name: Mission 9: The Gold Baron
description: The rival town is rich â€” their Gold Baron commands soldiers like water and leads from the front. Cut off their economy and break his army.

name: Mission 10: The Rival Capital
description: The rival capital â€” their greatest and most defended city. Conquer it and secure the entire region. The Raiders campaign unlocks when you win.

name: Mission 11: Shadows in the Market
description: Strange disappearances. Merchants robbed in broad daylight. The Thieves Guild has come to town â€” spies and cutthroats strike from the shadows.

name: Mission 12: The Guild Stronghold
description: The Thieves Guild operates from a fortified stronghold. Raid it and scatter them â€” the Spymaster cannot escape.

name: Mission 13: The Grand Heist
description: The remnants of the Thieves Guild attempt a grand heist on your treasury. Every rogue they have is on the streets. End this once and for all.

name: Mission 14: Arcane Interference
description: A rogue mage guild has turned their spells against your trade routes. Fire scorches fields and burns caravans. Root them out.

name: Mission 15: The Arcane Tower
description: The mage guild has fortified their tower. They wield fire and lightning â€” storm it before they grow too powerful to defeat.

name: Mission 16: The Grand Mage
description: The Archmage has gathered all power for one final assault. Fire elementals flood your streets. The deadliest battle you have fought.

name: Mission 17: The Dead Walk
description: A darkness has risen from the eastern crypts. The dead walk and the living fall. Your army must hold at any cost.

name: Mission 18: The Necromancer's Domain
description: The Necromancer's Graveyard is the source of the undead plague. Siege it and destroy it â€” or the dead will never stop rising.

name: Mission 19: Alliance of Darkness
description: The Thieves Guild and the Mage Guild have forged an unholy pact with the undead. Their combined force marches on the capital. Your greatest battle.

name: Mission 20: The Dark Throne
description: The Lich lord commands the ultimate army â€” undead, mages, and every dark power combined. Destroy the Dark Throne and bring peace to the land forever.

name: Raiders 1: Join the Warband
description: You have switched sides. The Warband's economy runs on loot and plunder â€” use Bag of Gold for instant income. Destroy the undefended town.

name: Raiders 2: Raid the Village
description: A village militia stands between you and the gold. Axe-throwers clear defenders from a distance â€” use them.

name: Raiders 3: Burn the Farms
description: Pillagers excel at destroying buildings. The town has started raising walls â€” burn it all before they finish.

name: Raiders 4: The Fighting Pit
description: The Fighting Pit trains your warriors just as the Barracks trains theirs. Build it and strike before their soldiers arrive.

name: Raiders 5: The Chief's Guard
description: The Town Chief himself leads the defense. Bring a Brute to crush the elite guards â€” raw strength beats discipline.

name: Raiders 6: Claim the Spoils
description: Stolen Treasure floods your warband with resources â€” the more the enemy has built, the more you take. Strike when their gold is flowing.

name: Raiders 7: The Grand Plunder
description: A wealthy town with a gold mine â€” the richest target you have ever raided. Drain their economy with Loot and tear down their buildings with Pillagers.

name: Raiders 8: Swords for Hire
description: The Warchief rides with you now â€” and so do Mercenaries who fight for any side that pays. The town is beginning to field Knights.

name: Raiders 9: The Final Forge
description: The Battle-Axe is the finest weapon in the Warband's arsenal. Win this battle and forge one for yourself.

name: Raiders 10: Sack the Capital
description: The capital. The wealthiest town in the land, defended by every knight and archer they have. Sack it and your legend is complete â€” for now.

name: Raiders 11: Thieves' City
description: The Thieves Guild city runs on shadow and gold â€” easier to crack than a fortified keep, but their spies are everywhere. Surprise them before they vanish.

name: Raiders 12: The Paladin's Keep
description: A keep defended by the realm's finest knights and blessed by a Paladin. Heavy armour, heavy faith â€” break them both.

name: Raiders 13: The Mage Spire
description: The Arcane Nexus crackles with power. Mages hurl fire from the battlements. Your brutes will need to push through the flames.

name: Raiders 14: Undead Catacombs
description: A Necromancer has raised the dead to guard a vast crypt treasure. The undead don't tire, don't flee â€” smash them anyway.

name: Raiders 15: The Hive Nest
description: A hive of alien creatures infests the valley â€” they breed fast, evolve faster, and swarm without mercy. Burn the nest to the ground.

name: Raiders 16: The Royal Army
description: The king's own army marches to stop the raids. Fully equipped with knights, archers, and watchtowers â€” your biggest human target yet.

name: Raiders 17: The Dark Alliance
description: The Thieves Guild and the undead have allied to stop your advance. Strange bedfellows â€” but deadly together. Tear them apart.

name: Raiders 18: Fire and Blood
description: The Mage Guild and the king's knights have joined forces. Fire rains from above while cavalry charges below. This is war on all fronts.

name: Raiders 19: The Lich's Kingdom
description: The Lich commands an endless undead empire from his fortress. His armies cannot be exhausted â€” but his throne can be broken.

name: Raiders 20: The Final Conquest
description: The ultimate target â€” the most fortified capital in the known world, defended by every faction. This is your legacy. Make it burn.

name: Mage Guild 1: Arcane Awakening
description: The Arcane Nexus stands. Your first apprentices are trained. A raider scouting party approaches â€” show them the power of fire.

name: Mage Guild 2: Reagent Gathering
description: Raiders have targeted your reagent stores. Drive them back with fire while your Mana Seers replenish your power.

name: Mage Guild 3: The Archmage Arrives
description: The Archmage has returned from his long journey. His power is unrivalled â€” lead with him as the raiders mass for a final assault.

name: Mage Guild 4: Burn the Camp
description: The Raider Camp must fall. Use Pyromancers to burn their buildings from a distance while Arcane Familiars harass their warriors.

name: Mage Guild 5: The Rival Tower
description: A rival mage tower has claimed your territory. Dismantle it â€” your Conjurers can hold the line while Pyromancers finish the job.

name: Mage Guild 6: The Town Defies Us
description: The town refuses to pay tribute to the guild. Their soldiers march on the nexus. Show them the difference between swords and sorcery.

name: Mage Guild 7: The Knights March
description: The town has sent their knights â€” heavy cavalry that even fire struggles to halt. Strike them with Arcane Rain before they close in.

name: Mage Guild 8: The Undead Problem
description: The Graveyard stirs â€” undead have begun attacking the nexus. They fear no fire, but they can be obliterated by raw arcane power.

name: Mage Guild 9: The Battle Mage Order
description: An order of Battle Mages has joined the nexus. Combined with the arcane arts they make an unstoppable force. Test them against the rival town capital.

name: Mage Guild 10: The Grand Coven
description: The Grand Coven â€” every rival mage house united against you. Fire meets fire, spell meets spell. Only one guild will stand when the storm clears. The Undead campaign unlocks when you win.

name: Mage Guild 11: Thieves in the Library
description: The Thieves Guild has broken into the guild library. They are after forbidden spellbooks â€” burn them before the knowledge is lost to the shadows.

name: Mage Guild 12: The Shadow Compact
description: The Thieves Guild has formed a compact with raider mercenaries. Their combined force threatens the nexus walls.

name: Mage Guild 13: Flames vs Shadows
description: The Spymaster leads a full assault on the nexus. Shadows extinguish flames â€” but not if you burn bright enough.

name: Mage Guild 14: Undead Swarm
description: The Lich has sent his undead legions to consume the nexus. Arcane fire cleanses the dead â€” but there are so many.

name: Mage Guild 15: The Necromancer's Gambit
description: The Necromancer himself rides to battle. He seeks arcane knowledge within the nexus to enhance his undead rituals. Deny him.

name: Mage Guild 16: The Hive Comes
description: The Hive has detected the magical energy of the nexus and swarms toward it. Their numbers are vast â€” burn them all.

name: Mage Guild 17: Allied Armies
description: Every faction has aligned against the guild â€” towns, undead, and thieves united by fear of arcane power. Stand your ground.

name: Mage Guild 18: The Siege of the Nexus
description: The ultimate siege. The Lich leads his undead empire against the nexus walls. The Archmage must hold â€” or burn everything.

name: Mage Guild 19: The Last Spell
description: One final enemy stands â€” the Broodmother leads the Hive against the weakened nexus. The Last Spell must be cast.

name: Mage Guild 20: Arcane Supremacy
description: Arcane Supremacy. The nexus stands above all. Defeat the ultimate coalition â€” the most powerful town ever assembled, backed by every faction's forces.

name: Undead 1: Rise of the Dead
description: The first dead stir from their graves. A small town militia patrols the border â€” show them what it means when the dead walk.

name: Undead 2: The Spreading Plague
description: The plague spreads. Shambling Corpses overwhelm the living through sheer numbers. A larger patrol stands in your way.

name: Undead 3: The Necromancer Rises
description: The Necromancer himself takes the field. With him at your side, the dead march in true formation. Drive back the town's defenders.

name: Undead 4: Assault on the Village
description: A walled village stands between you and the open road. Plague Zombies spread sickness before you even arrive. Destroy the Town Hall.

name: Undead 5: The Bone Collectors
description: After every battle, Bone Collectors harvest the fallen. Grow your army from the dead of the living. A stronger town awaits.

name: Undead 6: Dark Ritual
description: A Dark Ritual empowers your undead horde beyond natural limits. The town sends their archers â€” let the dark magic answer.

name: Undead 7: Curse of Rust
description: Curse of Rust corrodes armour and weapons alike. The raiders who laughed at your shambling dead will not be laughing when their blades crumble.

name: Undead 8: Grave Ghouls
description: Grave Ghouls stalk the battlefield, consuming the fallen to heal themselves. The Warchief sends his finest warriors â€” it will not be enough.

name: Undead 9: Flesh Golem
description: From the corpses of fallen knights, the Necromancer assembles a Flesh Golem â€” unstoppable, relentless, and utterly loyal. Prove its worth against the town capital.

name: Undead 10: The Undying Throne
description: The Undying Throne rises. Every champion of every faction has marched to stop the Necromancer. Let them come â€” the dead have no fear. The Thieves Guild campaign unlocks when you win.

name: Undead 11: Raider Vengeance
description: The Warchief swears vengeance for his fallen warriors. His full warband marches on the graveyard â€” they will join the dead soon enough.

name: Undead 12: The Mage's Folly
description: Foolish mages attempt to purge the undead with fire. The dead cannot burn what is already ash. Overrun the Arcane Nexus.

name: Undead 13: Thieves Rob the Crypts
description: The Thieves Guild has been plundering burial sites for necromantic artefacts. They will regret disturbing the dead.

name: Undead 14: The Hive Feasts
description: The Hive has discovered that undead flesh feeds their evolution. They swarm the graveyard seeking corpses. Let them try.

name: Undead 15: Plague Cloud
description: A Plague Cloud precedes your army, sickening enemies before the undead even arrive. The combined human forces learn this the hard way.

name: Undead 16: Bone Colossus
description: From the bones of a thousand fallen soldiers rises the Bone Colossus â€” a titan of death. Even the Lich's enemies pause when it marches.

name: Undead 17: The Lich Wakes
description: The Lich stirs from his slumber. With him awake, the dead are unstoppable. The mages send their fire â€” the Lich answers with darkness.

name: Undead 18: The Grand Deathmarch
description: The grand deathmarch begins. Every undead creature you have ever raised marches on the capital. Deathly Wails break enemy morale before a single blow is struck.

name: Undead 19: The Convergence
description: Every faction has converged to stop the Lich â€” raiders, thieves, mages, and the king's army march together. Even united, they are outnumbered by the dead.

name: Undead 20: Eternal Darkness
description: Eternal Darkness descends. The Lich raises a final army of the greatest undead ever assembled. The last bastion of the living falls today.

name: Thieves Guild 1: Shadow Initiate
description: You have joined the shadows. Spies observe without being seen, cutthroats strike without warning. A small town guard post is your first mark.

name: Thieves Guild 2: First Contract
description: Your first paid contract: eliminate a patrol and rob the merchant road. Footpads soften the targets before the cutthroats move in.

name: Thieves Guild 3: The Spymaster
description: The Spymaster himself takes the field for the first time. Under his command, the guild operates like a dark machine. Strike the town guard headquarters.

name: Thieves Guild 4: Knife in the Dark
description: Knife-throwers attack from a distance and are gone before the guards turn around. Raid the armory and take what you need.

name: Thieves Guild 5: The Informant Network
description: Informants inside every inn and guild hall feed you intelligence. Nothing moves in this town without the Spymaster knowing. Exploit it.

name: Thieves Guild 6: Shadow Blade
description: A Shadow Blade strikes once from nothing and vanishes. The warchief's finest guards cannot protect him from what they cannot see.

name: Thieves Guild 7: The Heist
description: The Grand Heist. The most fortified vault in the kingdom, guarded by knights and archers. Spies on the inside, cutthroats at the door, shadows everywhere.

name: Thieves Guild 8: The Mage Contract
description: The guild was hired to steal an arcane artefact. The mages noticed. Ambush them in the forest paths before they can cast their spells.

name: Thieves Guild 9: Guild War
description: A rival thieves guild has encroached on your territory. Dagger Throw and dirty tricks will settle this quickly â€” on your terms.

name: Thieves Guild 10: Guild Master
description: To become Guild Master you must defeat the current one â€” a veteran Spymaster who has survived every assassination attempt for twenty years. Not this one. The Hive campaign unlocks when you win.

name: Thieves Guild 11: Extortion Ring
description: The Extortion Racket squeezes gold from merchants without firing a blade. Some merchants hired knights to resist. Wrong choice.

name: Thieves Guild 12: Assassination
description: A high-value target: the Warchief of the raider warband. His coin is flowing to the wrong pockets. One Assassinate card changes everything.

name: Thieves Guild 13: The Master Thief
description: The Master Thief is the guild's finest operative. He strikes like a Cutthroat but leaves no evidence. Deploy him against the archmage's treasury.

name: Thieves Guild 14: The Undead Debt
description: The Necromancer owes the guild a debt from a century ago. He does not intend to pay. Collect it â€” in blood and bone.

name: Thieves Guild 15: The Hive Swarms
description: The Hive has no concept of gold or politics â€” it simply devours. A Venom Blade on the right target can stop a swarm before it starts.

name: Thieves Guild 16: The Royal Court
description: Spies planted in the royal court have triggered a crisis. Every guard in the kingdom is hunting the guild. Every guard is about to find out why that was a mistake.

name: Thieves Guild 17: The Shadow King's Pact
description: An alliance of shadow and steel â€” raiders hired as muscle, spies as intelligence. The combined force strikes the arcane nexus for the guild's final artefact.

name: Thieves Guild 18: The Lich Bargain
description: The Lich offered gold and power in exchange for the guild's loyalty. The guild counter-offered a knife. The dead are less negotiable than expected.

name: Thieves Guild 19: The King's Bounty
description: The king has placed a bounty on every member of the guild. The royal army, the mages, and the paladins all march under one banner. All are welcome to try.

name: Thieves Guild 20: The Final Shadow
description: The final mark: the king himself sits in the most fortified throne room ever built. The Shadow King needs no army â€” just one open window and one perfect blade.

name: Hive 1: The Spawning Pool
description: The Spawning Pool awakens. Your first Larva hatch and hunger. A town patrol has wandered too close. Feed.

name: Hive 2: First Swarm
description: The first swarm is always the hungriest. Ravagers lead, Larva follow. The town's soldiers have never faced anything like this.

name: Hive 3: The Broodmother Wakes
description: The Broodmother herself emerges from the depths. Every creature in the hive feels her will. A town outpost stands between her and the open plains.

name: Hive 4: Consume the Village
description: A walled village stands in the path of the swarm. Carapace Drones absorb arrows while Ravagers tear down the walls. Nothing is left behind.

name: Hive 5: Acid Spitters
description: Spitters dissolve armour from range. Soldiers behind stone walls have never considered that the walls themselves might melt.

name: Hive 6: Brood Warriors
description: Brood Warriors are the Hive's heavy infantry â€” evolved far beyond the larva they once were. The raider warband thought their axes would work. They do not.

name: Hive 7: Evolve and Consume
description: The Hive evolves between every battle. What the warchief faces today is not what his scouts reported. Overrun the raider camp before they can adapt.

name: Hive 8: The Hive Grows
description: Egg Clusters hatch faster than the enemy can kill. Bloated Spawn explode on death, dealing damage as they fall. The town's archers are about to learn a new fear.

name: Hive 9: The Mage Experiment
description: The mages tried to contain Hive specimens for study. The specimens had other ideas. Now the Arcane Nexus has a swarm problem â€” and so does the archmage.

name: Hive 10: The Great Swarm
description: The Great Swarm. A thousand creatures, one will. The best defended capital anyone has seen â€” and it will not be enough. Win and the Hive claims its first territory.

name: Hive 11: The Undead Lands
description: The undead do not flee, do not tire, and do not bleed. But they can be consumed. The Necromancer did not expect the swarm to evolve faster than his rituals.

name: Hive 12: The Shadow Nest
description: Thieves thought the abandoned nest made a good hideout. The nest was not abandoned. The nest was sleeping.

name: Hive 13: Wings Over the City
description: Winged Drones bypass walls entirely. The raider camp thought their watchtowers would give warning. They did not warn about the sky.

name: Hive 14: Evolved Hunters
description: Hardened Carapace makes even Larva difficult to kill. The combined mage and knight army has never fought something that keeps evolving between waves.

name: Hive 15: The Devouring Maw
description: The Devouring Maw consumes entire buildings whole. The Lich thought his Graveyard walls were a defence. He was wrong.

name: Hive 16: Toxic Mist
description: Toxic Mist precedes the swarm and weakens everything it touches. The royal army's finest armour does nothing against a cloud you cannot see to fight.

name: Hive 17: Regenerative Flesh
description: The Hive does not just evolve â€” it heals. Regenerative Flesh closes wounds mid-battle. The Spymaster's finest killers found that their blades left no lasting mark.

name: Hive 18: All Must Be Consumed
description: Every faction now fights the Hive as a single desperate coalition. Mages, raiders, undead and soldiers marching side by side. None of them have enough.

name: Hive 19: The Queen Rises
description: The Broodmother prepares her final evolution. While she ascends, the Lich makes one last desperate stand to stop the Hive from consuming his undead empire.

name: Hive 20: The World Consumed
description: The final battle. The world's greatest army â€” every hero, every soldier, every spell â€” assembled for one last stand against the Hive. There is no negotiation. There is only the swarm.
